en: Welcome to Lockwork's head office. Every crate that left a port in five regions was signed for on this floor.
You've undone four cells. You won't undo the fifth.
Fine. Go up. Keld will want to see the one who's been unpicking her locks.
The stairs are behind me. She's waiting by the machine.
The machine's stopped, but the crates still came back. Every one you knocked out went straight into my van.
Keld says I'm to hand them over. I say you'll have to take them, one ball at a time.
Whatever's still in the van, I'll have it here next time you come.
The van's empty. Every crate that came back has gone home with you. Good riddance to the lot.
